messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPUs queue growth detected in gcp-northamerica-northeast1. Autoscaler attempted scale-up but reports quota denial. Current queue length 12k, avg request latency spiking. Incident ID INC-3520

pagerduty-bot: paging Sara L (primary oncall) and Ops Rotation. Escalation policy: infra-team -> svc-rm.

Sara L: I'm on it. Can someone drop the autoscaler logs and the quota error? first check: are we hitting project GPU quota or regional resource limit?

Jamal K: copying autoscaler logs now. looks like GCE quota error 403: QUOTA_EXCEEDED for GPUs in region northamerica-northeast1. stack trace: `googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'NVIDIA_V100_GPUS' exceeded`

Alex P: Confirmed. Metrics show no free capacity in that region for the SKU we're requesting (a2-highgpu). Autoscaler retried 3x, then stopped triggering new attempts due to repeated 403.

Maria R: Customer impact: 2% of active requests experiencing timeouts, backlog growing for batch jobs. We're throttling some lower-priority queues to keep p95 for paid customers. Not yet SLA breach but trending. Updating status page draft.

Ops Rotation: I'm taking the page. Quick mitigation options: 1) Route new requests to us-central1/us-west2 pools, 2) Switch to quantized model variant with smaller GPU requirements, 3) Temporary quota increase request to GCP support (slow), 4) Preemptively evict low-priority workloads. Which order?

Sara L: Do 1 & 2 in parallel. Jamal, can you push a temporary routing rule to divert best-effort customers to us-central1? Alex, can you build and push the quantized variant rollout for northamerica-northeast1 that uses lower-memory gpus (t4-like)?

Jamal K: On it. Running lambda to update Smart Router policies now. Command: ```curl -X POST "$ROUTER_API/v1/rules" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"match":"customer_tier:best_effort","route":"region:us-central1"}'``` Will monitor traffic shift. ETA 3m.

Alex P: Starting a canary build of quantized-ggml v2 (lower VRAM) and queueing a canary rollout (10% traffic) to northamerica-northeast1. If that passes, we can expand to 50% and free a couple of a2 nodes. deploy snippet: ```roserve rollout create --model quant-ggml-v2 --region northamerica-northeast1 --percent 10```

Chris T: I'll start evicting scheduled low-priority batch jobs from the region. Running: ```kubectl delete job -l queue=best-effort -n inference```. Will pace to avoid thundering herd.

Sara L: Good. Also open a ticket with GCP support now (escalation). Maria, please draft the status update for customers (only mention service degradation and we are routing to adjacent regions). Keep wording calm.

Maria R: Drafting. Tagging product-incident for approval. Status: "We're experiencing capacity constraints in Montreal region affecting a small percent of requests. Our systems are diverting traffic to nearby regions; most customers see no impact. We're working to restore normal capacity"

Jamal K: Router change applied. Observing new route entries and 20% of best-effort traffic already draining to us-central1. Queue in northamerica-northeast1 dropped from 12k -> 9.2k in 4m. Latency for high-priority unchanged.

Alex P: Canary quant model looks healthy on 10%: p50/p95 within tolerance. Expanding to 40% now. If this frees 1 a2 node we can relieve more of the backlog.

oncall-bot: NOTE: autoscaler suspended further attempts to create nodes in region northamerica-northeast1 due to repeated quota errors. Manual action recommended.

Ops Rotation: If quant rollout and routing don't drop queue enough in 15m we should flip to full cross-region failover for non-enterprise traffic and open maintenance window with enterprise contacts. Also consider enabling smaller-instance fallback in node provisioner.

Jamal K: Cross-region failover ready flag set. I'm monitoring cross-region egress and cost delta. Ready to open failover at +10% cost impact threshold.

Chris T: Evictions completed for 6 low-priority jobs. Freed ~2.5k queued tokens. Still need more.

Maria R: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-3520 and sent to customers on the impacted list. No customer responses yet.

Sara L: Quick check: are there any spare reserved nodes in Dedicated accounts that can be borrowed? Alex?

Alex P: A handful in us-west2 are idle. Requesting detach+reassign to handle overflow. This will require gating permissions and a short routing rule. Doing it now. ETA 6m.

Jamal K: Router change to include us-west2 applied. We're seeing further queue drop to 5.6k. p95 for best-effort still elevated but stable.

oncall-bot: Pagerdurations: 45m active. Current severity set to Sev2.

Sara L: Great work. Slack handoff in 20m to next oncall: Ops Rotation please prepare a short runbook summary and open a retrospective note. If GCP support doesn't approve a quota increase in 2 hours escalate to cloud-svcs.

Ops Rotation: Copy. I'll take the next shift. Adding runbook: summary of actions (router reroute -> quant rollout -> evict jobs -> borrow dedicated nodes). Leaving notes on steps to revert.

Jamal K: GCP support ticket created (case 2501943). Acknowledged, but timeline unknown. Asked for immediate quota bump for GPU SKU a2-highgpu.

Sara L: I'll update exec-ops after this handoff. Thanks team. Leaving page to Ops Rotation.

Ops Rotation: Acknowledged, taking over. Monitoring dashboards live. If queue doesn't hit <1k within 90m, escalate to Sev1 and notify Customer Success for direct outreach.

Chris T: Leaving a couple of diagnostic snippets here for the postmortem: ```gcloud compute regions describe northamerica-northeast1 --project redwood-inference``` ```kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=autoscaler -o wide``` Also saved autoscaler logs to gs://redwood-incident-logs/INC-3520/

Maria R: I'll keep the status page cadence at 30m. Next update scheduled in 28m.

oncall-bot: Handoff complete. New owner: Ops Rotation. Thread locked for critical updates only"
